integrity: The proof uses exact common-neighbour geometry and inclusion-exclusion. The supplied code verifies finite instances independently but cannot certify an infinite theorem by itself. Known general homomorphism identities and small counts are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two features and three values per feature on labelled complete bipartite graphs. The probability law refers to uniform selection among absorbing states, not to absorption probabilities induced by dynamics. Historical priority is conditional on the accessible comparison literature. No independently validated mathematical assessment.
title: A sharp five-to-three-culture transition in frozen Axelrod states on bicliques
